question.problem:
What is $73\,\text{kg}$ expressed in $\text{g}?$ Write your answer as a whole number.

$73\,\text{kg}=$
{{field-1}}$\text{g}$
question.worked_solution:
We start by recalling the conversion table for mass units. 

| Name | Symbol | Conversion |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Kilogram | $\text{kg}$ | $1\,\text{kg}=1\,000\,\text{g}$ |
| Gram | $\text{g}$ | Base Unit |
| Milligram | $\text{mg}$ | $1\,000\,\text{mg}=1\,\text{g}$ |

$$

$$

There are $1000\,\text{g}$ per $\text{kg},$ which we can write as follows:

$$
\frac{1000\,\text{g}}{\text{kg}}
$$

This is our conversion factor.

Now, multiplying $73\,\text{kg}$ by our conversion factor, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}73\,\text{kg} & =73\,\text{kg}\cdot \frac{1\,000\,\text{g}}{\text{kg}} \\  & =73\,\cancel{\text{kg}}\cdot \frac{1\,000\,\text{g}}{\cancel{\text{kg}}} \\  & =73\cdot 1\,000\,\text{g} \\  & =73\,000\,\text{g}.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, $73\,\text{kg}$ is equivalent to $73\,000\,\text{g}.$
